subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] sched/numa: scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode

2026-09-18.patch_summary: Gregory Price's patch to scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode is met with criticism from Lorenzo Stoakes, who objects to the introduction of a VMA helper and suggests that it may not be doing what it intends to do.
